remarks: Fabulous opportunity to own your own home and enjoy all Ventura has to offer!  This 2nd floor, move-in ready, 1 bedroom, 1 bath unit is generously sized and wonderfully located within the complex which features great amenities and lush grounds. The interior is very calming, light and bright with views of the treeline and blue skies. Enjoy our nearly perfect weather on your balcony as you rejuvenate with the ocean air. The tasteful decor (furnishings offered) and open floor plan contribute to a feeling of spaciousness.
